# TechPlay

> TechPlay is a gaming and technology media outlet from Bosnia and Herzegovina. We publish hardware reviews with benchmark data, gaming news, PC build guides, and esports coverage. Our editorial team includes hardware engineers and competitive gamers with years of hands-on testing experience.

## Content

- [News](/news) — Daily gaming and technology news, industry announcements, and esports results
- [Reviews](/reviews) — In-depth hardware and game reviews with scored ratings, benchmark comparisons, and expert verdicts
- [Hardware](/hardware) — PC hardware analysis, component benchmarks, and buying recommendations
- [Guides](/guides) — Step-by-step gaming guides, build tutorials, optimization tips, and how-tos
- [Games Database](/games) — Searchable database of 1M+ games with specs, release dates, and metadata
- [Videos](/videos) — Video reviews, benchmark visualizations, and streams
- [Forum](/forum) — Community Q&A, build advice, and gaming discussions
- [Calendar](/calendar) — Gaming release dates and industry events

## Editorial Standards

- All hardware reviews include measured benchmark data (FPS, thermals, power draw)
- Reviews use a 1–10 scoring system documented at [/rating-system](/rating-system)
- Content is written by identified authors with disclosed expertise
- News sources are cited; editorial opinions are clearly labelled
